title: Famous Food of Every Indian State and Union Territory: A Complete Table
seoTitle: Famous Food of Indian States and UTs: Full Table
seoDescription: Famous food of all 28 Indian states and 8 UTs: signature dish, daily staple and sweet for each, plus the food items that hold a verified GI tag.
excerpt: All 36 states and union territories in six regional tables, with the dish each is known for, what people eat daily, a local sweet, and GI-tagged foods checked against APEDA's official list.
